newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH MAN FINDS CAT AND MICE SHARING CAR TRUNK.
newsitem.headline: POLISH MAN FINDS CAT AND MICE SHARING CAR TRUNK.

text.p: When changing a flat tyre a Polish man found a cat and a family of mice living side-by-side in his car's trunk, PAP news agency reported on Saturday.
The man was so moved by the pasteral scene in his car's boot that he decided to put the old vehicle on blocks and feed its new inhabitants for the remainder of the cold winter.
The unlikely trunk-mates crept into the boot through a rust hole in the bottom of the trunk, PAP said.
